lines: The three-way battle had been increasing in intensity.
The demonic spider leaped up with a swiftness that didn't match its massive body.
It fell at high speed from overhead and tried to crush Shizuku.
Shizuku vanished at the last moment, easily avoiding it.
Several Fuma ninja who'd been attacking Shizuku got caught up and crushed flat by the demonic spider.
Several people's worth of a repulsive red stain spread over the ground.
Taking no notice of his subordinates' deaths, Library slashed at Saburo with his blades that now burned red-hot.
Living up to his name as the Head of the Fuma Oniwaban, his swift movements resembled the fierceness of a gale.
Saburo made Daigoro raise its leg in an attempt to block the slash.
The demonic spider's leg, stronger than steel, stopped the burning blade.
But that was only for a momentー
Library exhaled sharply, and his superheated blade forcefully melted the outer shell, then severed it.
Black blood gushed out, but it was instantly evaporated by the heat of the blade.
The demonic spider let out an awful raspy shriek like metal grating metal, and it couldn't help but flee backwards.
Library made the calm announcement, then further stepped in to follow up on the strike.
Despite its master's fluster, Daigoro let out a howl of rage and tried to unleash its deadly spider web.
As if he'd known what to expect, Library disappeared, melting into his surroundings, before the spider web was released.
The massive volume of spider webbing missed their mark and just fruitlessly painted the surroundings white.
Faster than Saburo could issue her next command, Library appeared behind the demonic spider and swung his blade at it.
Taking a severe wound on its back, the demonic spider let out a painful roar.
Saburo was able to finally perceive Library only after her demonic spider had been cut.
Daigoro was no longer waiting for Saburo's commands, and now instinctively tried to escape using its severed foreleg to try and dig into the earth.
D-Don't run away! Daigoro!! Stop! Daigoro!!
Saburo's shrill voice desperately ordered Daigoro to stop its retreat.
Excellent control of the demonic spider. But you still lack training compared to your predecessor.
Staring at Saburo and the demonic spider, Library spoke quietly.
If Library had gone all out in his strike earlier, Saburo and Daigoro would both have been killed.
He had struck the demonic spider, intentionally avoiding its vital parts.
As Saburo stared at Library, her eyes reflected fear for her enemy for the first time since she had come to Gosha Village.
I'm Taimanin Library. One who has sworn allegiance to Fuma Kotaro.
Fuma Kotaro? The Diot, Fuma Kotaro? Why would you ever do that for someone that weak?
Saburo's scornful words were merely an attempt to hide her fear.
A master of shinobi needs more than physical strength. He must have the capacity to lead, which makes others devote their lives to them.
Capacity? And you're saying that Diot has such a thing?
Of course. If not then I wouldn't be here.
Saburo was intimidated into silence by Library's determined voice and strong conviction that said more than words.
If you swear allegiance to my master, I will not take your life. What do you say?
L-Laughable. I swear allegiance only to Nisha Gaiza.
Saburo spoke as if to cling to her pride as a follower of Gaiza.
The next strike would surely bring the battle to a decisive end.
Saburo forcefully gave the order to the demonic spider that had tried to escape earlier.
Daigoro once again gave a fierce roar and released spider webbing from its spread jaw.
The demonic spider's strands fanned out in all directions around Daigoro, forming an enormous spiderweb to protect its master.
Its radius was approximately 10 meters. The boundaries of the demonic spiderweb, which never let go of anyone who touched them, could intercept the enemy no matter where they came from.
I'm Onigumo Saburo, and I serve Gaiza-sama. Come at me!
The demonic spiderweb vibrated slightly at the sound.
Library, who revealed himself once again, had set his entire body ablaze.
The spiderweb boundaries burned away as soon as Library touched itーno, even before that.
Library rushed toward Saburo like a ball of fire.
There was no longer any place to run.
The moment Saburo had prepared to meet her fate...
Two intersecting swords had been unleashed at ultra-high speed and parried Library's burning blades.
With the appearance of this new enemy, Library backed away by riding the momentum of the two swords that had saved Saburo.
It was Shonosuke who rescued Saburo from her predicament.
Taimanin Library-dono, was it? I don't believe we've had the pleasure.
Shonosuke, having saved Saburo's life, bowed his head in a composed manner.
It was an obvious opening, but Library didn't so much as twitch.
I do apologize for this sudden intrusion. And I also beg pardon for the impudent actions of these two on behalf of the Nisha.
So you didn't come here for the Master's life?
That is not my mission as of today.
Yes. Today I'm just a guardian of these two restless children.
You don't seem very well suited to the role.
To my utmost shame. To avoid further trouble, would you please allow us to return home?
Now that she was saved, Saburo raised her voice in protest.
Before anyone could notice, Shizuku had gone missing.
Could I ask this of you?
Shonosuke and Library stared at one another for a brief period.
You have my gratitude. Now let's go, Saburo.
Ghngh...  You'll be sorry for this!!
Leaving with those cliched words, the demonic spider with Saburo and Shonosuke on its back fled with a great leap.
Library at last lifted his superheating and turned to his remaining men.
Follow Onigumo Saburo and Shonosuke! But do not engage. Keep your distance and continue monitoring them!
Don't force any needless battles. So long as they leave Gosha territory, all's well.
The Oniwaban promptly set off in pursuit.
Now all that's left is that boy. Since I was tasked with him I have to do something.
Library muttered to himself and then disappeared into thin air in pursuit of Shizuku.
